dct_creator_sm: Jemmett, William S. (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Due to scale issues with the map, Inlailawatash 4A is out of location and was not georeferenced.

Georeferenced map of Squamish Nation reserves: Capilano 5, Mission 1, Seymour Creek 2, Kitsilano 6; and Tsleil-Waututh Nation Burrard Inlet 3 reserve. Reserve No. 4 Inlailawatash 4 at the north end of Indian Arm was not georeferenced. Land cover and features described on the map includes First Narrows, trails, roads, Coal Harbour, and the types of timber.
